description: Shared online student-PPT layout contract reconstructed from the twelve finalized Lesson 01-06 PPTX files.
lesson_specific_content_source: lesson canonical-source.json plus lesson-specific online-content-contract.json; lesson data overrides layout defaults

visual.background_policy: 投影片主畫布固定純白；暖白只用於局部卡片、圖片框或插畫內容，不作整張投影片背景。

effective_typography_policy.autofit: allowed only when the rendered effective size remains at least 20 pt
effective_typography_policy.validation: inspect explicit and inherited a:rPr/a:defRPr size plus fontScale; confirm with full rendered preview
effective_typography_policy.historical_reference_exceptions: The finalized L01-L06 files contain isolated inherited 18 pt/default and script-field anomalies; do not copy them into new drafts.

cover.title_policy: lesson-specific value between 44 and 50 pt; never add a bottom subtitle

goals.title: 学完这课后，我能……
goals.label: 听懂 · 介绍 · 讨论 · 准备
goals.item_count_policy: lesson-specific; finalized L01-L03/L05-L06 use four items and finalized L04 uses three
goals.source_policy: must come from the lesson-specific content contract; no generic goals or another lesson's protagonist

vocabulary.divider_subtitle: 看图、读音、词类、意思、用法和例句。
vocabulary.practice_title: 请你说说它们的中文并造句
vocabulary.meaning_policy: required per vocabulary item; student-facing meaning must be Vietnamese vocabulary, never English and never a Chinese or English fallback
vocabulary.usage_policy: lesson-specific and word-specific when supplied; blank is allowed; do not synthesize a generic explanation from part of speech
vocabulary.optional_field_policy: render only when the lesson content contract supplies non-empty text; otherwise omit both the label and the empty field
vocabulary.extension_policy: word_specific_optional; never show an empty universal extension label
vocabulary.grammar_detail_policy: word_specific_optional; may remain blank until explicitly supplied
vocabulary.example_policy: new lesson drafts require exactly two explicit short sentences from the lesson example bank; never generate filler or copy a long textbook sentence
vocabulary.page_breaks_policy: The entries above are audited Lesson 02-04 source-page mappings only; future lessons must derive printed-page breaks from their own canonical source/content contract and may not inherit these numbers.

reading.summary_instruction: 先听音档 {audio}，再写本课要求的简单摘要。

expressions.student_instruction: 用这个句式写出三句话

slides.title: 我觉得很难的地方
slides.prompt: 写下你不太懂的词语、句式、短文或听力内容。

slides.title: 课前检查
checks: 我已经学完本课所有词语，知道它们的意思和用法。
我已经听完本课所有听力音频。
我已经按本课要求为三段短文写好摘要。
我已经记下听不懂的词语、句式、短文或听力内容。
我已经学完本课所有句式，并完成每个句式的练习。
我已经完成课本第{table_page}页的表格。
我已经按本课要求写好个人介绍，并使用指定的课本词语和句式。
我已经准备好在课堂介绍自己。

fonts.script_policy: CJK Hanzi uses KaiTi at run level; Vietnamese, pinyin and other Latin-script text uses Times New Roman at run level.
